description: The expiring/rejected credential notice ('Pair T3 again before the credential stops working…') has no action (flag #51). The only fix is inside the collapsed 'Control settings' disclosure, which is closed by default once a session exists, and nothing points to it.
expected: A 'Pair again' button in the notice that opens Control settings and focuses the T3 pairing code field, or an inline pairing-code field in the notice.
actual: Notice text only. Maya must find and expand Control settings herself.
suggested_fix: Add a 'Pair again…' button to the notice that sets the details open and focuses #t3-pairing-code.

description: When T3 has rejected the credential (401), the header notice still says 'Pair T3 again before the credential stops working', and the status line reads 'rejected · expires 11/11/2026'. Both suggest the credential still works.
expected: For rejected or expired credentials: 'T3 no longer accepts this credential. Pair again to resume.' with no future expiry date.
actual: Copy written for the expiring state is reused for the rejected state.
suggested_fix: Choose the notice text and the expiry fragment by credential status (expiring / expired / rejected).
